sections.heading: Digit at a glance
sections.body: Digit is the modern ERP for manufacturers and distributors. One AI native platform for production, inventory, warehouse, and ops. Deploys in days. Integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, and more.

sections.heading: Where it may fit in a shortlist
sections.body: Based on its positioning under ERP, Digit is most relevant during early market discovery. The available record includes 12 category signals and 2 commercial records, giving buyers a starting point—not a substitute for requirements validation.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before buying
sections.body: Ask Digit for a workflow-specific demonstration, itemized pricing, implementation responsibilities, data-processing terms, support response targets, and references from organizations with a similar scale and use case.

sections.heading: Our research perspective
sections.body: The strongest signal in this assessment is audience fit; the area requiring the most buyer diligence is buying detail. These signals describe documentation quality and should not be read as measured product performance.

faq.question: What is Digit?
faq.answer: Digit is the modern ERP for manufacturers and distributors. One AI native platform for production, inventory, warehouse, and ops. Deploys in days. Integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, and more.

faq.question: Did Pangu Medianet hands-on test Digit?
faq.answer: No. This generated assessment is based on the supplied structured partner record and clearly identified vendor information.

faq.question: How is the Digit score calculated?
faq.answer: The research score weights product clarity (28%), audience fit (24%), buyer access (18%), buying detail (18%), and record confidence (12%). It evaluates available buying information, not product performance.

faq.question: Who should consider Digit?
faq.answer: Teams comparing erp options may use this brief as a starting point, then confirm workflow, pricing, implementation, security, and support requirements directly with the vendor.
